senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; מָלַל I)ripe ear, esp. parched ear.—Pl. מְלִילוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 4:5">Maasr. IV, 5</cite> <he>המולל מ׳</he> he who rubs parched ears; <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 1:20">Tosef. Bets. I, 20</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 3:18">Tosef. Ter. III, 18</cite> … <he>הכניס שובלין … לעשותן מ׳</he> if one brought ears to his house with the intention of parching them.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 3:1:12">Y. Pes. III, beg. 29ᵈ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00884"><he>עָמִיל</he></cite>.
